subject: Demo recap + POC plan for FinTechProspect
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@fintechprospect.com>, Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@fintechprospect.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + POC plan for FinTechProspect

Hi Samir / Aisha —

Thanks again for the time this morning — great conversation and appreciate the clear articulation of your goals for the pilot. Quick recap and a proposed POC approach attached so you can share with the wider team. High-level summary below: 

- What we demoed: Redwood hosted inference with streaming chat, routing to a quantized model variant for cost-sensitive flows, and prefix caching for common queries.
- Top priority for your team: reduce answer latency for customer support flows to < 300ms p50 while maintaining helpfulness for compliance-related questions.
- Success criteria (from our call):
  - Latency p50 < 300ms for triaged support prompts
  - Answer accuracy >= 88% on the provided rubric (we'll use your test set)
  - No PII leakage in logs; audit trail enabled for all calls

Attached: POC-outline.docx (plan, timelines, responsibilities) and the demo recording link. Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm the evaluation test set and success threshold (deadline: EOD Thu 3/12)
2) Kickoff call week of 3/16 — 2-week POC (recommended)
3) Redwood will provide a sandbox workspace, sample ingestion script, and a dedicated engineer for onboarding

Please find the attached POC outline and let me know if you want any changes before I lock timelines. Happy to jump on a quick follow-up if useful.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachment: POC-outline.docx (3 pages)
Link: https://redwood-inference.sharepoint.com/:v:/s/demos/POC-recording

From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@fintechprospect.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@fintechprospect.com>, Joe Mendoza <joe.mendoza@fintechprospect.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + POC plan for FinTechProspect

Hey Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap and the plan. This looks good overall. A few clarifying items from our side before we lock dates: 

- Test set: we'll provide a 500-sample set pulled from last quarter's support transcripts (Aisha will send by EOD Wed 3/11).
- Success thresholds: the 88% accuracy target sounds reasonable; our legal team also wants a short summary of the logging/audit controls you mentioned. Can you include the SOC2 controls and log retention options in the plan?
- Timeline: 2-week POC is preferred. Proposed kickoff 3/17.

Can you also confirm what level of access we need to provide for the sandbox (S3 access + API key ok?) and whether there are any limits on concurrent calls we should be aware of during the POC.

If those look fine we'll send a mutual action plan and get the procurement thread started.

—Samir
Samir Shah
Head of Product Operations | FinTechProspect
samir.shah@fintechprospect.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@fintechprospect.com>, Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@fintechprospect.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + POC plan for FinTechProspect

Samir — really appreciate the quick reply and the clarity. Answers inline below and I've updated the POC outline to include the SOC 2 / logging notes. Attaching updated file and the demo recording for internal stakeholders.

- Test set: perfect — we'll expect the 500-sample CSV from Aisha by 2026-03-11 EOD.
- Logs / controls: SOC 2 Type II summary + options for 30/90/365 day retention are summarized in section 4 of the attached POC-outline.docx. During the POC we can enable 30-day retention with audit logging; if you need notes for procurement we can generate the SOC 2 extract doc and a sample audit log export.
- Sandbox access: S3 + API key works. We'll provide an S3 ingestion template and temporary API key scoped to the POC workspace. Concurrent calls: default sandbox quota will be 20 concurrent streams; we can raise to 50 for short load windows if you let us know expected peak windows.
- Kickoff: confirmed for Wed 2026-03-17 10:00am PT — I'll send a calendar invite once we have final attendee list.

Next steps for FinTechProspect:
- Aisha: send the 500-sample test set (due EOD 3/11)
- Samir: confirm procurement point-of-contact for DocuSign / SOW (we'll need sign-off on the POC engagement)
- Marissa / Redwood: provision sandbox + temp API key; assign dedicated engineer (ETA 3/16)

I'll also open a short procurement thread to include legal and procurement contacts so we can get the DocuSign started.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: POC-outline.docx (v1.1)
Link: https://redwood-inference.sharepoint.com/:v:/s/demos/POC-recording

Marissa / Neha / Team —

Saw the thread and the updated POC outline. I'll be the technical lead for the POC and can start on provisioning tomorrow (3/11). Action items on our side:
- Assign dedicated engineer: Miguel Alvarez (internal) — onboarding ETA 3/16
- Provision sandbox workspace and generate temp API key by EOD 3/16
